title: A Witness for the Verdict
author: Wren Nystrom
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
